mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT ( CONTENT_NO, TMDB_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, TITLE, ORIGINAL_TITLE, OVERVIEW, POSTER_PATH, BACKDROP_PATH, RELEASE_DATE, GENRE_TEXT, RUNTIME, EPISODE_COUNT, DIRECTOR, CAST_NAMES, AGE_RATING, TMDB_SCORE, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{tmdbId}, #{contentType}, #{title}, #{originalTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{overview, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{posterPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{backdropPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{releaseDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{genreText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{runtime, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{episodeCount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{director, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{castNames, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ageRating, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tmdbScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT TMDB_ID AS "tmdbId", CONTENT_TYPE AS "contentType", TITLE AS "title" FROM CONTENT
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT SET GENRE_TEXT = #{genreText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RUNTIME = #{runtime, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, EPISODE_COUNT = #{episodeCount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DIRECTOR = #{director, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST_NAMES = #{castNames, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AGE_RATING = #{ageRating, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TMDB_ID = #{tmdbId} AND CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}
mapper.select: SELECT PLATFORM_NO FROM OTT_PLATFORM WHERE UPPER(TRIM(PLATFORM_NAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{platformName})) AND IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'

SELECT PLATFORM_NO AS "platformNo", PLATFORM_NAME AS "platformName", LOGO_IMAGE AS "logoImage", SITE_URL AS "siteUrl", IS_ACTIVE AS "isActive" FROM OTT_PLATFORM WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY PLATFORM_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT_PLATFORM ( CONTENT_PLATFORM_NO, CONTENT_NO, PLATFORM_NO, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_PLATFORM_NO.NEXTVAL, #{contentNo}, #{platformNo}, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO ACTOR ( ACTOR_NO, TMDB_ACTOR_ID, ACTOR_NAME, PROFILE_PATH ) VALUES ( SEQ_ACTOR_NO.NEXTVAL, #{tmdbActorId}, #{actorName}, #{profilePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO CONTENT_ACTOR ( CONTENT_ACTOR_NO, CONTENT_NO, ACTOR_NO, CHARACTER_NAME, DISPLAY_ORDER ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_ACTOR_NO.NEXTVAL, #{contentNo}, #{actorNo}, #{characterName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{displayOrder, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
INSERT INTO DIRECTOR ( DIRECTOR_NO, TMDB_DIRECTOR_ID, DIRECTOR_NAME, PROFILE_PATH ) VALUES ( SEQ_DIRECTOR_NO.NEXTVAL, #{tmdbDirectorId}, #{directorName}, #{profilePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO CONTENT_DIRECTOR ( CONTENT_DIRECTOR_NO, CONTENT_NO, DIRECTOR_NO, DIRECTOR_TYPE, DISPLAY_ORDER ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_DIRECTOR_NO.NEXTVAL, #{contentNo}, #{directorNo}, #{directorType}, #{displayOrder, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
